_note: The dictionary: every key and every form this tool understands, in one file. Look things up here, copy the job that does what you want. The file is split into `batches` (one per engine here; the UI shows each batch as a tab): the top-level `defaults` apply to every batch, a batch's `defaults` are laid over them, and a job repeats a key only to change it. A value REPLACES the one below it as a whole (a job's `loras` list replaces the batch's list, it is not added to it). Only `model` and `prompt` are required (`version` may be left out; it says which format the file is in, and 1 is the only one): leave any other key out and the engine's own tested value is used (`jenair engines` lists them). Images go to outputs/<output>/<batch name>/<model>/. With only one batch you may write `defaults` + `jobs` at the top level instead (basics/02-batch.json). Keys starting with `_` are comments. The basics/ files show each idea alone.

defaults._note: Shared by every batch below, written once. A batch or a job that gives `seed` or `seeds` replaces them.

batches._note: illustrious (SDXL): the jobs below show the size, seeds, sampling, negative, LoRA and your-files forms on one engine.
batches.name: illustrious

defaults._note: This batch's own defaults, laid over the top-level ones. From `steps` down are the sampling settings; these are the values for illustrious (SDXL). Delete any of them to get the engine default. `sampler` and `scheduler` are ComfyUI's names.
defaults.negative: lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, watermark, text

jobs._note: Nothing but a name and a prompt: everything else comes from the defaults. 2 seeds = 2 images.
jobs.name: forest
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, walking through a sunlit forest, long coat, looking up, leaves falling, soft light

jobs._note: Override the size with another aspect...
jobs.name: beach-wide
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, standing on a beach at sunset, white dress, wind in her hair, soft light

jobs._note: ...or with an exact width and height.
jobs.name: beach-banner
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, standing on a beach at sunset, white dress, wind in her hair, soft light

jobs._note: Override the seeds: this job renders once, with seed 42...
jobs.name: library
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, reading in an old library, round glasses, stacks of books, soft light

jobs._note: ...or a list of seeds: one image per seed.
jobs.name: library-three
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, reading in an old library, round glasses, stacks of books, soft light

jobs._note: Override the sampling: fewer steps, lower CFG, another sampler and scheduler.
jobs.name: forest-tuned
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, walking through a sunlit forest, long coat, looking up, leaves falling, soft light

jobs._note: A sampler name copied from a model card (Euler a, DPM++ 2M Karras, DPM++ SDE Karras, UniPC, ...) already includes its scheduler, so the batch's `scheduler` is handed back with null (null = the engine's own default).
jobs.name: forest-card-sampler
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, walking through a sunlit forest, long coat, looking up, leaves falling, soft light

jobs._note: Override the negative prompt for one job.
jobs.name: forest-negative
jobs.negative: lowres, bad hands, watermark, text, dark, night
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, walking through a sunlit forest, long coat, looking up, leaves falling, soft light

jobs._note: Override the LoRAs: the list replaces the default one, so repeat a LoRA you want to keep. Here niji is weaker and a second LoRA is added. A LoRA entry is a name, or {name, scale, trigger}: `trigger` words are put in front of the prompt (built-in LoRAs already know theirs).
jobs.name: forest-two-loras
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, walking through a sunlit forest, long coat, looking up, leaves falling, soft light

jobs._note: `trigger`: "" uses a built-in LoRA without adding its trigger word.
jobs.name: forest-no-trigger
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, walking through a sunlit forest, long coat, looking up, leaves falling, soft light

jobs._note: No LoRA for this job: an empty list.
jobs.name: forest-no-lora
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, walking through a sunlit forest, long coat, looking up, leaves falling, soft light

jobs._note: A checkpoint by address: an SDXL-type file (illustrious engine), so the defaults of this batch fit as they are. Its images go in a folder named after the file.
jobs.name: forest-checkpoint-by-address
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, walking through a sunlit forest, long coat, looking up, leaves falling, soft light

jobs._note: YOUR FILES. The next two jobs (and my-finetune in the zimage batch) need a file of yours, so they carry skip: true - put the file in place and delete the `skip` line. This one: models/checkpoints/my-checkpoint.safetensors, used by its file name (with or without .safetensors).
jobs.name: my-checkpoint
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, walking through a sunlit forest, long coat, looking up, leaves falling, soft light

jobs._note: models/loras/my-lora.safetensors (or models/loras/illustrious/my-lora.safetensors to have the engine checked), with its trigger word.
jobs.name: my-lora
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, walking through a sunlit forest, long coat, looking up, leaves falling, soft light

batches._note: krea2. A batch only needs the defaults its engine wants: nothing from the illustrious batch is handed down.
batches.name: krea2

jobs._note: A LoRA by address (hf://owner/repo[@revision]/path or https://...): nothing to download first. It knows no trigger, so give one.
jobs.name: greenhouse-lora-by-address
jobs.prompt: Inside an old glass greenhouse full of ferns and orchids, a watering can on a wooden bench.

batches._note: zimage: no negative prompt and a fixed CFG of 1, and its prompts are sentences, not tags.
batches.name: zimage

jobs._note: A built-in LoRA in the short form: a name, full strength.
jobs.name: forest-zimage
jobs.prompt: A young woman in a long coat walking through a sunlit forest, looking up as leaves fall around her.

jobs._note: A model as an object, for the engines made of three files (zimage, krea2, qwen, klein): `engine`, the files you replace (`diffusion`, `text_encoder`, `vae`; `checkpoint` for illustrious) as addresses or file names in models/, and `name` for the output folder. Files you leave out are the engine's official ones. A fine-tune usually replaces `diffusion`: "diffusion": "hf://someone/their-finetune/model.safetensors". This example replaces only the small VAE (with the official one, from its address) so that running it does not download a second 12 GB model.
jobs.name: cafe-model-object
jobs.prompt: A quiet neighborhood cafe at dawn, warm light through tall windows, steam rising from a cup on a wooden counter.

jobs._note: A fine-tune of a three-file engine: models/diffusion_models/zimage/my-zimage-finetune.safetensors. The folder name says which engine it is; text encoder and VAE are the official ones.
jobs.name: my-finetune
jobs.prompt: A young woman in a long coat walking through a sunlit forest, looking up as leaves fall around her.

batches._note: Several models in one batch: one image per prompt, model and seed. With engines that differ, give no LoRAs and leave the sampling to each engine.
batches.name: compare

jobs.name: cafe-compare
jobs.prompt: A quiet neighborhood cafe at dawn, warm light through tall windows, steam rising from a cup on a wooden counter.

batches._note: skip: true on a batch keeps it in the file without rendering any of its jobs (on a job it skips that job).
batches.name: later

jobs.name: not-yet
jobs.prompt: A lighthouse in a storm.
